"The Trump administration may be within days of launching a nuclear strike on
Iran," according to a solemn
[tweet](https://x.com/TuckerCarlson/status/2117071025955389828) posted Sunday
by far-right talk show host Tucker Carlson.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Carlson's tweet, which bizarrely claims former President Barack Obama opposed
recent peace negotiations, in no way means that Donald Trump is actually
preparing to use the bomb against Iran. The Trump administration loves, to the
point of [parody](https://puck.news/washington/2026/6/barak-ravids-direct-
line-to-trump-led-to-credibility-crisis), "leaking" hypothetical war plans -
or peace plans - to pressure Tehran or to soothe markets. Or, as Carlson's
[neo-Nazi rival Nick Fuentes](https://zeteo.com/p/donald-trump-nick-fuentes)
[alleges](https://x.com/NickJFuentes/status/2117340146827718838?s=20), Carlson
fabricated the story so he can later claim that Vice President JD Vance, whom
Carlson praises in the tweet and has [improbably](https://zeteo.com/p/jd-
vance-maga-israel-iran-democrats) promoted as a principled anti-war
presidential candidate, successfully averted nuclear disaster.
